import importlib.util
import os
import tempfile
import unittest
from pathlib import Path
from unittest.mock import patch


ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[2]
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("native_config", ROOT / "scripts" / "native_config.py")
native_config = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
assert SPEC.loader is not None
SPEC.loader.exec_module(native_config)


class NativeConfigTest(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_uses_loopback_defaults_and_infrastructure_port_overrides(self):
        with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as directory:
            dotenv = Path(directory) / ".env"
            dotenv.write_text(
                "LW_NATIVE_CLICKHOUSE_TCP_PORT=19111\nLW_NATIVE_NATS_PORT=4223\nLW_INTERNAL_TOKEN=test-token\n",
                encoding="utf-8",
            )
            environment = {"LW_INFRA_ENV_FILE": str(dotenv), "STATISTIC_NATIVE_HTTP_PORT": "18090"}
            with patch.dict(os.environ, environment, clear=True):
                actual, public = native_config.native_environment()

        self.assertEqual("127.0.0.1", actual["STAT_HTTP_HOST"])
        self.assertEqual("18090", actual["STAT_HTTP_PORT"])
        self.assertEqual("tcp://127.0.0.1:19111?database=default", actual["STAT_CLICKHOUSE_DSN"])
        self.assertEqual("nats://127.0.0.1:4223", actual["STAT_NATS_URL"])
        self.assertEqual("test-token", actual["STAT_INTERNAL_TOKEN"])
        self.assertEqual("127.0.0.1:18090", public["http"])


if __name__ == "__main__":
    unittest.main()
